_README: Manual scope verdicts for notification-census call sites, applied after build_census_mod.py's static classifier. Keyed by '<mod-relative file>#<message key>#<nth occurrence of that key in that file>' -- stable across regeneration, unlike a line number or the manifest's sequential id. Value is one of: country | non_country | unknown.
_WHEN_TO_EDIT: After a calibrate run. Demote a site to 'non_country' if it produced 'Wrong scope for trigger: <type>, expected country' in error.log; promote one to 'country' if it logged clean SNW_CENSUS|P| lines, which stops it paying for the redundant world line. scan_logs.py --census names the candidates.
